title: Clubs · Удержание
description: Когорты и возвраты по запускам Mini App (app_opened), затихшие клубы.

panels.title: Сейчас
panels.description: Недели календарные по Москве. Журнал запусков ведётся с 2026-10-15. DAU усредняется по дням, когда запуски были, — дни без запусков в среднее не входят.

targets.rawSql:
with wk as (
  select distinct user_id, date_trunc('week', created_at at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' as w
  from product_event
  where kind = 'app_opened' and user_id is not null
)
select
  (select count(*) from wk where w = date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') as "На этой неделе",
  (select count(*) from wk where w = date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' - interval '7 days') as "На прошлой неделе",
  (select count(*) from wk a
     where a.w = date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow'
       and exists (select 1 from wk b where b.user_id = a.user_id and b.w = a.w - interval '7 days')) as "Были и на прошлой",
  (select count(distinct user_id) from product_event
     where kind = 'app_opened' and user_id is not null and created_at >= now() - interval '28 days') as "MAU (28 дней)",
  (select round(avg(d), 1) from (
     select count(distinct user_id) as d from product_event
     where kind = 'app_opened' and user_id is not null and created_at >= now() - interval '28 days'
     group by date_trunc('day', created_at at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') t) as "DAU в среднем по дням с запусками (28 дней)"

panels.title: Когорты по неделе первого запуска, % вернувшихся
panels.description: В7: кто из запустивших приложение на неделе N запустил на неделе N+k. Пусто — неделя ещё не прошла. Все, кто пользовался приложением до 2026-10-15, попадают в первую когорту.

targets.rawSql:
with first as (
  select user_id, min(date_trunc('week', created_at at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') as cohort
  from product_event
  where kind = 'app_opened' and user_id is not null
  group by 1
),
acts as (
  select distinct user_id, date_trunc('week', created_at at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' as w
  from product_event
  where kind = 'app_opened' and user_id is not null
)
select to_char(f.cohort at time zone 'Europe/Moscow', 'DD.MM.YYYY') as "Неделя с",
  count(*) as "Людей",
  case when date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' >= f.cohort + interval '7 days'
       then round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (
              select 1 from acts a where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.w = f.cohort + interval '7 days'))
            / count(*), 0) end as "Нед. +1" ,
  case when date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' >= f.cohort + interval '14 days'
       then round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (
              select 1 from acts a where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.w = f.cohort + interval '14 days'))
            / count(*), 0) end as "Нед. +2" ,
  case when date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' >= f.cohort + interval '21 days'
       then round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (
              select 1 from acts a where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.w = f.cohort + interval '21 days'))
            / count(*), 0) end as "Нед. +3" ,
  case when date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' >= f.cohort + interval '28 days'
       then round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (
              select 1 from acts a where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.w = f.cohort + interval '28 days'))
            / count(*), 0) end as "Нед. +4" 
from first f
where $__timeFilter(f.cohort)
group by f.cohort
order by f.cohort desc

with wk as (
  select distinct user_id, date_trunc('week', created_at at time zone 'Europe/Moscow') at time zone 'Europe/Moscow' as w
  from product_event
  where kind = 'app_opened' and user_id is not null
),
first as (select user_id, min(w) as first_w from wk group by 1)
select wk.w as time,
  count(*) filter (where wk.w = f.first_w) as "Новые",
  count(*) filter (where wk.w > f.first_w and exists (
    select 1 from wk p where p.user_id = wk.user_id and p.w = wk.w - interval '7 days')) as "Были и на прошлой неделе",
  count(*) filter (where wk.w > f.first_w and not exists (
    select 1 from wk p where p.user_id = wk.user_id and p.w = wk.w - interval '7 days')) as "Вернулись после перерыва"
from wk
join first f on f.user_id = wk.user_id
where $__timeFilter(wk.w)
group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Клубы с чатом, в которых затихли
panels.description: Никто не открывал экраны клуба 14 дней (или ни разу с 2026-10-15).

targets.rawSql:
with last_seen as (
  select club_id, max(created_at) as at
  from product_event
  where kind = 'screen_opened' and club_id is not null
  group by 1
),
members as (
  select club_id, count(*) as cnt from memberships where status = 'active' group by 1
)
select c.name as "Клуб",
  s.at as "Последняя активность в приложении",
  (current_date - (s.at at time zone 'Europe/Moscow')::date) as "Дней тишины",
  coalesce(m.cnt, 0) as "Участников"
from clubs c
join club_chat_links l on l.club_id = c.id
left join last_seen s on s.club_id = c.id
left join members m on m.club_id = c.id
where c.is_active and l.bot_status in ('member', 'administrator')
  and (s.at is null or s.at < now() - interval '14 days')
order by s.at nulls first
